messages.english: Save a reviewed plan from your own growing estimates.
messages.translation: Gcina uhlelo olubukeziwe olusuka ezilinganisweni zakho zokulima.

messages.english: Check unresolved crop records before using a finance forecast.
messages.translation: Hlola amarekhodi ezitshalo angakaxazululwa ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isibikezelo sezimali.

messages.english: Keep saved growing estimates and nursery settings when signing in.
messages.translation: Gcina izilinganiso zokulima ezigciniwe nezilungiselelo zendawo yokukhulisela izithombo lapho ungena ku-akhawunti.

messages.english: Production plan → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.translation: Uhlelo lokukhiqiza → Uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olusuka ezilinganisweni zakho

messages.english: Review a complete proposal, save all its planned cycles, then open dated work.
messages.translation: Bukeza isiphakamiso esiphelele, ugcine yonke imijikelezo yaso ehleliwe, bese uvula umsebenzi onosuku.
